findings.title: The diff-trimming loops can overlap, which crashes the verifier with StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
findings.body:
The suffix loop at line 107 is limited only by the full string lengths, so `start + end` can be larger than the length of `value` or `sanitized`. Example: a translation with a missing `

`, such as `

a

b

`. The sanitizer returns `

a

b

`, which gives start=5 and end=8. Line 111 then calls `value.substring(5, 4)` and throws. The plugin crashes instead of reporting `Illegal HTML`, and this is exactly the kind of translation mistake the check is meant to catch. Fix: limit the suffix loop so it never reaches characters the prefix loop already counted.

findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax, which i18next does not interpolate.
findings.body: The account UI translates this key on the client with i18next, as the earlier `{{0}}` placeholders show. `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}` are not interpolated there, so users will see the raw placeholders and choice syntax in the validation error. I could not check how the account UI translates this error. Revert to `{{n}}` placeholders, or use i18next pluralization.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax, which i18next does not interpolate.
findings.body: The admin UI bundle uses i18next interpolation (`{{error}}`, `{{fieldName}}` in nearby keys), and the old value used `{{0}}`. The new value uses `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}`, which i18next leaves as they are. The user-profile multivalued-size error will show raw text like "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}." I could not check how the admin UI translates this error. Keep the i18next form here, or use i18next plurals.

findings.title: Limit the suffix scan so it cannot overlap the common prefix.
findings.body: This is the one-line fix for the substring crash described above: stop the suffix scan before it reaches characters already counted in `start`.

findings.body: "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" is written in Traditional Chinese (zh_TW) characters, but this is the zh_CN file. Use the Simplified form.
